events.title: Hype spike
events.description: One SKU runs HOT for a few days.

events.title: Soft rotation leak
events.description: Research or a Specialist can foreshadow a rotation.

events.title: Counterfeit scare
events.description: News flash — graded trust drops; Inspect is mandatory on slabs; shady lots look worse.

events.title: Convention weekend
events.description: Calendar weekend — the floor gets busier and whales show up more often.

events.title: Theft ring
events.description: Optional rumor — extra shrink on the floor for a few days. Staff coverage helps; otherwise wait it out.

events.title: Recession week
events.description: Macro ticker — all demand softens and walk-in sellers pile up. Liquidate staples, cut buys, or ride it out.

events.title: Supply glut
events.description: Distributor email — sealed wholesale drops and the floor races. Buy deep cheap, skim, or skip; cut price or hold margin.
